CustomField.description: Display label used by the Lead conversion screen when listing household members. Marks the primary holder and anyone already converted, so the agent can see the whole household at a glance.
CustomField.formula: TRIM(BLANKVALUE(FirstName, "") & " " & LastName) & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(TEXT(Familial_Relationship__c))), " (" & TEXT(Familial_Relationship__c) & ")", "") & IF(Is_Primaryholder__c, " (Primary)", "") & IF(NOT(ISBLANK(Contact__c)), " - 이미 전환됨", "")
CustomField.label: Household Choice Label
